interfaces.mean_consumption: Force = ionic_force - G_active - G_held - C*u + support_force. Scalar = sum_s w_s Tr(H0_s rho_s) + dv/2 sum(delta_n*Kdelta_n) + u.(G_active+G_held-ionic_force-support_force) + u.C.u/2 + sum(p*p/M)/2. delta_n=n_active+n_held-nbar. Affine probe constant=direction.(ionic_force+support_force-G_held); probe electronic action remains -g and ionic linear readout -C. Boundary diagnostics consume the same scalar.

scalar_contract.formula: U=e2/2 sum_ijR' ZiZj erfc(sqrt(alpha)*|Ri-Rj-R|)/|Ri-Rj-R| + e2*2pi/Omega sum_G!=0 exp(-G^2/(4alpha))*|sum_i Zi exp(iG.Ri)|^2/G^2 - e2*sqrt(alpha/pi)*sum_i Zi^2 - e2*pi*(sum_i Zi)^2/(2alpha*Omega), e2=2 in Ry.
scalar_contract.boundary: Ordinary 3D periodic Ewald, uniform neutralizing background/G=0 convention, conducting/tinfoil boundary, no surface dipole/ESM/2D/MT corrections.
scalar_contract.finite_sums: Real pair-distance sphere and full signed physical reciprocal sphere with explicit cutoffs. Complete lattice boxes use inverse-axis bounds; pair displacement is refolded as in rgen. Exact self i=j,R=0 excluded, periodic self images included in energy; self/background constants retained. Distinct coincident ions rejected rather than omitted. Real pair derivative assembled antisymmetrically from the scalar pair, never by subtracting a final net force.
scalar_contract.differentiability: Hard real cutoff means a piecewise smooth finite scalar. Analytic derivative holds geometry cell, alpha and cutoffs fixed on a branch with no shell crossing; evaluation within 64*machine-epsilon times the physical length scale of a crossing is rejected. Minimum real-cutoff distance is returned. Derivative does not include cutoff-surface distribution terms or cell stress.
scalar_contract.honest_native_difference: QE ewald.f90 selects alpha downward from2.8 using1e-7 energy bound and real4/sqrt(alpha); force_ew selects downward from1.0 with1e-6 energy bound and real5/sqrt(alpha). This implementation deliberately uses one declared finite scalar instead, so no bitwise Native energy/force identity is claimed. It also replaces rgen's near-zero 1e-10 alat-squared exclusion with exact self exclusion/singular-distinct-ion rejection, and has no mxr=50 cap.
scalar_contract.curvature: Only F_II at the expansion point enters PreparedReference. Fixed supplied joint-second-order C is retained, including its already-present ionic/reference frozen-electron curvature. Neither full displaced Ewald energy nor an additional ionic Hessian is inserted. The absolute reference Ewald scalar is diagnostic; PreparedReference keeps its irrelevant additive energy constant at zero.
